name: Amaze — everyday care
carrier: Amaze Health (Denver, CO) — a membership, not insurance

brochures.code: Amaze's Welcome to Amaze sheet (7 pages), its member sheet (What Amaze includes + Setting up your account) and its Support FAQ
brochures.file: tool/docs/amaze-welcome.pdf (from Jesse, 19 Nov 2026); amaze-overview.pdf and amaze-setup.pdf (via Health ZONE, 7 Nov 2026); amazehealth.com Support FAQ read 27 Oct 2026
notes: Amaze is a membership for everyday care, not insurance. It does not pay hospital, ER, surgery or specialist bills — that is what the Cigna plan is for.
Amaze is $99 a month for the household (Jesse, 19 Nov). Amaze's own site prints no price; click the price on the row to change it if the client's figure differs.

Do not sell it as a copay saver: $99 a month is $1,188 a year, and five primary-care visits on Cigna 7350 cost $250 in copays. It buys any-time access and breadth. On the HSA plans, where every visit is deductible + 20%, it does replace real money.

Amaze publishes no drug list for the membership. Look up a client's drug on Rx Valet's own search (myrxvalet.com/medications) or in the Rx Valet app; do not quote a savings percentage or a pharmacy count. The 1,100-generic $0 list and the 37-drug ACUTE program found online belong to other plans built on Amaze (Strategic Health Share, Capstone Plus) — do not promise either.
Second opinions are not a stated feature anywhere in Amaze's material — do not promise one.
Do not repeat Amaze's own usage or ER-reduction percentages; they are company claims.
If the membership is cancelled the free features stay (search, video library, symptom checker); the medical care is what the subscription buys.
Enrol through your own Amaze sign-up link (Setup). The link decides who is credited.
